#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Independent differential acceptance harness: reference executable vs node port.
# Compares stdout, stderr (pid-normalized) and exit code. Prints only failures.
EXE=/workspace/dataset/test8_executable
CAND=(node /output/test8.mjs)

pass=0; fail=0
norm() { sed -E 's/\[PYI-[0-9]+:ERROR\]/[PYI-N:ERROR]/'; }

cmp_case() {
  "$EXE" "$@" >/tmp/_r.out 2>/tmp/_r.err; rrc=$?
  "${CAND[@]}" "$@" >/tmp/_c.out 2>/tmp/_c.err; crc=$?
  norm </tmp/_r.err >/tmp/_r.errn; norm </tmp/_c.err >/tmp/_c.errn
  local bad=""
  cmp -s /tmp/_r.out /tmp/_c.out || bad="$bad stdout"
  cmp -s /tmp/_r.errn /tmp/_c.errn || bad="$bad stderr"
  [ "$rrc" = "$crc" ] || bad="$bad exit($rrc vs $crc)"
  if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
    fail=$((fail+1))
    printf 'FAIL[%s] argv:' "$bad"; printf ' %q' "$@"; printf '\n'
    printf '   ref.out: %s\n' "$(od -c </tmp/_r.out | head -3 | tr '\n' '|')"
    printf '   cnd.out: %s\n' "$(od -c </tmp/_c.out | head -3 | tr '\n' '|')"
    if [[ "$bad" == *stderr* ]]; then
      printf '   err diff: %s\n' "$(diff /tmp/_r.errn /tmp/_c.errn | head -6 | tr '\n' '|')"
    fi
  else
    pass=$((pass+1))
  fi
}

echo "== documented samples =="
cmp_case --a 135 --b 67  --c binary
cmp_case --a 18  --b 189 --c end
cmp_case --a 79  --b 139 --c packet
cmp_case --a 20  --b 183 --c abcdef
